basic_info.description: Experience a fresh vibe in the Sunset at 1779 29th Ave, fully renovated 4BD/3BA home designed for modern indoor-outdoor living. The vibrant exterior features a custom paint scheme by San Francisco's own Bob Buckter, aka Dr. Color. Inside, the main level offers a bright living room with a sleek fireplace, a chef-inspired kitchen with premium appliances, and two bedrooms with partial ocean views and direct deck access. Two spa-like bathrooms round out this level with tasteful tile and contemporary finishes. The lower level includes a media lounge with wet bar, full bath, and two more bedrooms that open to a professionally designed lush backyard, shaded patio, newer perimeter fencing and irrigation system . A solar-powered garden office, offers a peaceful workspace amid manicured landscaping. Ideally located just minutes from Noriega shops, restaurants, top-rated schools, Muni, and outdoor gems like Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, and Stern Grove. Stylish, flexible, and full of Sunset energy, this is the one.
